lockup.summary: The company, its officers, directors and holders of 5% or more of Class A shares agreed not to sell shares for 180 days. The underwriter's representative can give written consent to sell earlier.

what: ChainOn provides technology services in Hong Kong, including blockchain software projects, cloud hosting, and project and hardware maintenance.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about US$27.67 million. About 40% goes to research and technology, 20% to sales and marketing, 20% to hiring, 10% to possible strategic investments, and 10% to working capital.
risks: Errors, bugs or security flaws in its technology services could cost it customers, hurt its reputation and raise its costs.
If customers cannot complete or are unhappy with acceptance tests, projects may be delayed and final payment may not be received.
If it cannot raise the money needed to run and grow the business, its results and its ability to continue as a going concern could suffer.
If it fails to keep up with fast-changing technology in Hong Kong, its business and growth prospects could be seriously harmed.
risks_note: The first 4 risk factors, summarised by AI.
